title: Toshkent zilzilasi 1966: 300 mingga yaqin odam uysiz qoldi

scenes.text: 1966 yil 26 aprel tongida zilzila Toshkentda taxminan 300 ming odamni uysiz qoldirdi.
Zilzila markazi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri shahar markazi ostida, yer yuziga juda yaqin edi.
Kuchi taxminan 5 magnituda edi, lekin markazdagi eski loy uylarning ko'pi qulab tushdi.
Shahar qayta qurildi. Bugun o'sha tong xotirasiga Jasorat yodgorligi turibdi.

description:
1966 yil 26 aprel tongida Toshkentda zilzila bo'ldi. Markazi shahar ostida va yer yuziga yaqin edi, kuchi taxminan 5 magnituda. Taxminan 300 ming odam uysiz qoldi. Shahar qayta qurildi, xotirasiga Jasorat yodgorligi o'rnatildi.

Oilangizda o'sha kunni eslaydiganlar bormi? Izohda yozing.
source: Web fact-check 2026-11-20 (web search summaries; Wikipedia could not be opened from this session). Wikipedia '1966 Tashkent earthquake' (26 April 1966, Mw about 5.1-5.3, focal depth 3-8 km under the city, estimates of homeless 200,000-300,000, about 78,000 families; official death toll 15); USGS Historic Earthquakes archive (event listing); uzbekistan.travel and advantour.com (Courage Monument at the epicentre area, black cube with the date and time of the quake; inauguration year given as 1970 or 1976, so the text gives no year). Note: 300,000 is the upper end of the estimates, hedged with 'taxminan' and 'mingga yaqin'.
